WITH facebook_users AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.users
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.user_id,
    oi.order_id,
    oi.created_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.user_id ORDER BY oi.created_at) AS order_sequence
  FROM public.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM facebook_users)
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
distinct_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, order_id, created_at, order_sequence
  FROM user_orders
),
order_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    u1.user_id,
    u1.order_id AS first_order_id,
    u2.order_id AS second_order_id,
    u1.created_at AS first_order_date,
    u2.created_at AS second_order_date,
    (u2.created_at::date - u1.created_at::date) AS days_between
  FROM distinct_orders u1
  JOIN distinct_orders u2 ON u1.user_id = u2.user_id
    AND u2.order_sequence = u1.order_sequence + 1
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between) AS median_days
FROM order_pairs

WITH new_users_2024 AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    created_at,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::date AS acquisition_month
  FROM public.users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
users_with_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    nu.id,
    nu.acquisition_month,
    CASE 
      WHEN oi.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 
      ELSE 0 
    END AS had_non_cancelled_order
  FROM new_users_2024 nu
  LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi 
    ON oi.user_id = nu.id 
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= nu.created_at 
    AND oi.created_at < nu.created_at + interval '30 days'
),
monthly_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    acquisition_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total_users,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN had_non_cancelled_order = 1 THEN id END) AS users_with_orders,
    ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN had_non_cancelled_order = 1 THEN id END)::double precision / 
           NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT id), 0))::numeric, 4) AS order_placement_rate
  FROM users_with_orders
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  TO_CHAR(acquisition_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS acquisition_month,
  order_placement_rate
FROM monthly_stats
ORDER BY order_placement_rate DESC

    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_id,
    order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) as order_rank
  FROM user_orders
),
first_second_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 1 THEN order_date END) as first_order_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 2 THEN order_date END) as second_order_date
  FROM ranked_orders
  WHERE order_rank <= 2
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
),
days_between AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (second_order_date - first_order_date)) as days_diff
  FROM first_second_orders
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff) as median_days
FROM days_between

  SELECT 
    user_id,

    SUM(sale_price) AS order_value,

  GROUP BY user_id, order_id, created_at
  ORDER BY user_id, created_at
),
first_orders AS (
  SELECT order_value
  FROM order_values
  WHERE order_sequence = 1
),
repeat_orders AS (
  SELECT order_value
  FROM order_values
  WHERE order_sequence > 1
),
first_median AS (
  SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) AS median_value
  FROM first_orders
),

  SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) AS median_value
  FROM repeat_orders
)
